{
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "text": "After fiscal year 2018 Apple stopped filing under the legacy us‑gaap 'Revenues' concept and began using the newer 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' concept due to ASC 606 adoption, so the old concept simply has no rows after 2018.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT fiscal_year, concept, COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(value_usd) AS total_rev
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193
  AND concept IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax')
GROUP BY fiscal_year, concept
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "The EDGAR ingestion pipeline experienced a coverage gap for Apple’s filings after a certain date (e.g., due to a temporary API throttling or CIK‑match failure), so no facts—including those under 'Revenues'—were loaded for periods beyond FY 2018.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT MAX(filed_date) AS latest_filing,
       MIN(filed_date) AS earliest_filing
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193;
-- Additionally, check if any rows exist for any concept after 2018:
SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193
  AND fiscal_year > 2018
GROUP BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "Duplicate filing handling logic inadvertently removed older 'Revenues' facts when a later filing (e.g., an amended 10‑K/A) with the same period but a later filed_date was ingested, leaving only the newest version which may have omitted the legacy concept.",
      "how_to_test": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cik, concept, period_start, period_end
                            ORDER BY filed_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM edgar.revenue_facts
  WHERE cik = 320193
    AND concept = 'Revenues'
)
SELECT fiscal_year,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 END) AS latest_fact_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN 1 END) AS older_fact_count
FROM ranked
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "Apple reclassified a portion of its revenue (e.g., services, licensing) into separate line items that are no longer captured under the aggregate 'Revenues' concept, causing the reported total under that concept to appear flat or missing after 2018 while overall revenue continues to rise.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT fiscal_year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN concept = 'Revenues' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_legacy,
       SUM(CASE WHEN concept = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_new,
       SUM(CASE WHEN concept NOT IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax') THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS other_concepts
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    }
  ]
}
